hero.subheadline: Plan a focused St. Augustine trip with practical highlights, local context, and easy tour connections.

overview: St. Augustine, Florida is a strong base for travelers who want a concise mix of landmark stops, local neighborhoods, and outdoor time. This Tier-2 guide gives you quick planning coverage with essential experiences and practical pacing. Start each day with one anchor attraction, then add a nearby activity to reduce transit time and keep your St. Augustine itinerary efficient while still feeling varied and local.

faq.a: Two to three days is enough for core St. Augustine highlights plus one or two local experiences.
